entries.quote: AP-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research
entries.observation: Fetched 2026-09-21 (title 'AP-NORC'). Observed: active 2026 research including 'State of the Facts 2026', Trump/ICE immigration approval studies, an Iran war study, an 'America 250' poll, the Media Insight Project, and AAPI Data collaborations; the center is the AP's long-standing survey research partner.

Fetched 2026-09-21: eagleton.rutgers.edu (Eagleton Institute) and eagletonpoll.rutgers.edu both resolve. Observed: the Rutgers-Eagleton Poll with press releases and a public data archive; director Ashley Koning; surveys fielded on the SSRS Garden State Panel (probability-based, multi-mode); ECPIP described as the oldest university-based statewide survey research center; the institute notes Monmouth University Polling Institute closed in March 2025, leaving Eagleton as New Jersey's main academic poll.
